title: A toolbar in the center column must still show every control at 1,100 px with the inspector open
rule: The center column (main.list) clips its overflow and is only about 540 px wide at 1,100 px with the sidebar and inspector open. A new toolbar there must wrap (`flex-wrap: wrap`, `min-height` instead of a fixed `height`) or move controls to a second row, so no button or status text falls outside the column, also in German. Add a Playwright check at a 1,100 px viewport in en-US and de-DE that asserts each toolbar control's bounding box sits inside main.list and that a focused button is fully in view.
rationale: E22.2 (#147): the catalog toolbar was a fixed 48 px non-wrapping row; below ~1,265 px with the inspector open, Refresh and its date were clipped out of view.
